A survival romance in a cold and suspicious castle begins!  
  
Adrian wants to avoid getting married in any way but he was given the emperor's command to marry Marchioness Frey Busia, who's also known as the "Wolf of the Battlefield".  
  
Soon enough, Frey had already signed the marriage contract!  
  
Now, I'm married. But why is it impossible to see her?  
  
Marchioness Frey Busia.  
  
Rumors say that she would kill anyone who sees her face.  
  
Can Adrian melt her cold heart?

Jealousy is the sequel to Confession.

In the Apollinaire Empire, where birds are considered sacred, an oracle was passed down from generation to generation that the empire would enjoy eternal glory on the day the divine bird made of silver and gold descends. Richard, the young emperor of the Apollinaire Empire, discovers God's egg brought by his companion bird, Dullahan, and takes care of it with all his heart. On the day when the egg finally cracked, what came out of the egg with much anticipation was... "Churi-churi!" It was a small bird that made a sound I had never heard before.

Foi uma confiança que veio de um passado distante.

Cada interpretação era diferente, mas as pessoas esperavam que o '(Pássaro Divino)' descesse um dia a esta terra.

Um dia pacífico, centenas de anos depois. Um “ovo” do tamanho de um punho do céu desceu sobre esta terra.

Though Hannah has lost her memory after nearly drowning, she stays strong, enduring Lady Charlotte’s daily abuse in hopes of a better future. But everything changes when Vincent asks her to pose as Princess Lisselotte for the 10th-anniversary ceremony of the Jarthewer Republic. Returning means certain death both for her and the princess, but if they can pull off the deception, it may be their only chance at freedom. Stuck between the handsome but cold Vincent and his mischievous and buff guard, Diego, can Hannah succeed in her dangerous role?

Yu Pyeonghwa wants to get along with others even at a loss.
Love and peace, who have lived conflicting lives, meet each other and learn a new way of life.

description.en: Deep in the remote mountains, there lived a young boy named Nakbin with his shaman mother. Nakbin longs to venture into the world, but his mother constantly forbade him from doing so. This was because Nakbin possessed extraordinary shamanic abilities. All his mother wished for was a normal life for her son. But despite her efforts, Nakbin’s power went out of control. Nakbin’s unrestrained power grew as he invoked numerous gods one after another. Even though his mother fought the gods bravely, she was ultimately overcome by their immense might. The small child stepped in and defended his mother just in time before a powerful ancient god smite her down. The god, moved by Nakbin’s purity and bravery, retreated. However, as it withdrew, it left behind a terrible prophecy for Nakbin. He might become the chosen shaman, one with the potential to either save or destroy the world, a being known as the “Ancient Earth God”.

description.en: What lies in worlds beyond our own? Is it a bright light and then… nothingness? Or is it another land populated with gorgeous beauty and eldritch horror beyond our recognition? General Hwee-un falls in battle, leaving behind his unspoken love and a life unlived and awakens in a… forest? Malevolent spirits and demons vie for his life until a handsome goblin whisks him away to the Goblin Village and into the court of the Goblin King. Whatever life may exist in the beyond, death is only the beginning.
“Is it wrong to have a dirty mind?” A story about a girl whose relationship with her boyfriend crumbles whenever she has wild thoughts

title.en: A Survival Guide for D-Class Guides

description.en:
In a world where gates suddenly appeared, Espers were like a national power. South Korea's representative S-Class Esper, Cha Jaewoo, had a problem: after he gained his powers, he couldn't find a guide who had a high match rate with him. 

Thus, it was mandated that all citizens must take the guide test. 

"No way... I really hope this is not the case, but..."
"Haa..."
"...Is it Cha Jaewoo?" 

Haeyool took the test, thinking he might as well get it over with, and he set a record of an unprecedented 97.8% match rate with Cha Jaewoo! 

"So what? I'm a D-Class...!" 

Cha Jaewoo was an S-Class Esper who had never received proper guiding before and was on the verge of exploding, while Haeyool was a pathetic D-Class Guide. Wouldn't even something like going after a boss monster as soon as you select your character be a better choice than that? Haeyool was about to refuse, having lost all energy at the thought that he might die, but... 

"If a guide for Esper Cha Jaewoo doesn't appear, then he will be killed."
'...A-Are they insane?' 

Just who was he worrying about, when he might die if he accepted? But after hearing that if he didn't become Cha Jaewoo's guide, the Esper would die, Haeyool swallowed his tears and signed the contract. 

"Um... I already did today's amount this morning..."
"That's it?"
"That's the best I can do..." 

Afterward, Haeyool lived in one house with Cha Jaewoo and a particle-sized amount of mana. He ended up guiding him once a day, but...

Hahyun, a practical dance department graduate from Korean Arts High School; at the request of his uncle, he became a stand-in for an idol audition program, Survival ID.    As originally planned, Hahyun received the “edited,” “invisible,” “rapid fail” ending, but was able to survive every stage with the help(?) of fans…    ‘Uncle, I want to get off… TT'    Hahyun, who once loved dancing injured his body, and abandoned all his dreams.     "Since I gave up, what is this reality that debut is nearing again?"    “Sunbae, I like your dancing.”    Besides, where did the participant ‘Jigu’ who knows Hahyun’s past come from?!

After suddenly dying at the age of 17, Emily opens her eyes again as Jane, a poor fallen noble. To survive, she needs to find a job. As a noblewoman, being a tutor seems like a simple enough job. However, the student she has to teach is the only successor of Duke Kleinfelt - Samuel Kleinfelt. The ill tempered child in front of her is the man who cut off her neck in her past life and was the worst enemy who ruined Lindell, the Dukes family. ‘Alright, I'll raise this brat well and prevent future tragedies.’ ‘Call me Teacher Jane. Teacher Jane.’ ‘What an eyesore. Die, old maid.’ His words are like those of a beast and his attitude is savage. Can I really tame this scoundrel?

description.en: The year when her father, a mountaineer, died on Mt. Everest, Ujuu met an alien on the mountain behind her neighborhood and became an alien fan. Because of this, when she said that she met an alien before, she ended up being bullied. She decided to carefully hide her interest in aliens and pretending to be normal became her life motto. At a strange location, she happened to find a flyer for a club named Alien Tracker. In that club, Mun Heemun, the most popular guy in school, joins as a new member but gives off a strange feeling.

description.en:
This story begins like any other, with a tragic death and reawakening in a new world. Kang Yerin, after being hit by a truck, wakes up as Ashleigh Lute, the second daughter of a noble household. Without the burden of being the firstborn or the need to earn a living, “Ashleigh” expected to live worry-free. But, what should’ve been a cushy life in high society, soon turns into one life-threatening hassle after another. Pulled in every direction, she is forced to go on a quest to defeat the Demon King, forced to keep her heroic quest a secret, and forced to re-enroll at the academy she left behind years ago, making her a downright “fossil” compared to her peers. Still, anything is better than living with her cold-blooded sister, openly known to have killed her own brother and possibly their parents too. Or so Ashleigh thought until she realized both princes attending the academy were after her allegiance in their pursuit for the throne. Trapped under her murderous older sister’s thumb and stuck between a sibling rivalry over the crown, Ashleigh can never seem to catch a break. In a twisted irony, how hard will Ashleigh Lute have to work to be able to live the easy life she’s always wanted?

What is a sweet, soft-spoken girl (Ha Li Kang) to do when her brothers, having just learned fencing and martial arts, decide to test some moves out on her in order to "tame her" and make her into their "little slave?" She runs to her knightly friend (Te Hu Kang, not related to Ha Li) for protection, of course. However, what happens when, instead of comforting her, he tells her that she is a coward for running away like a puppy who needs constant protection? No, she does not break down and cry like a weak girl. Instead, she resolves to grow stronger. With rigorous training everyday, Ha Li goes from being a scared girl who cries for help to becoming the Jjang (boss of a gang) of the Doberman gang. However, events lead to Ha Li getting in an accident with a truck. Afterwards, she is reborn into the body of a beautiful, but weak, rich girl Aram Han.  
  
At her new school, everyone is surprised at the sudden change they see in Aram, who has gone from a gloomy, good student to a rude, carefree troublemaker. Many people bully her. When Ha Li finds out that it is all due to Sin Uoo Park, the handsome prince and Jjang of the school who detests Aram, she decides to have a duel with him for the position of Jjang. What will happen next is for you to find out in this romantic comedy Korean manhwa.

description.en:
In elementary school, Ban Hana was always the tallest in her class.
But while everyone else kept growing… she didn’t.
Now in high school, Hana finds herself face-to-face with a tall, broad-shouldered boy she barely recognizes — so tall she has to crane her neck just to meet his eyes.
And that boy?
It’s Han Gyeol — the same kid who used to be shorter than her.
The height difference hasn’t changed.
It’s still 35 centimeters.
But this time, everything else has.
A story about a 35-centimeter gap — and how their positions completely flipped

description.en: In showbiz, anything can make or break you – top actor Eunseong knows this all too well. A video of him confronting a stalker fan has gone viral and it could derail his career! His managers insist he needs to boost his image somehow. Enter Woojoo, the main dancer for a struggling idol group called Noble. They're total opposites: Eunseong is cold and commanding, while Woojoo is sweet and naive. But they're perfect for a “show-window bromance,” a fake friendship to make Eunseong look more appealing as he pretends to take Woojoo under his wing. As the unlikely duo becomes more popular, the stalker's return could destroy not only their fame, but their very lives… But is their bromance really all an act and nothing more?

The goodwill from the start didn’t last long.

At the House that adopted me due to my affinity with elemental spirits, I lived a life detested by even the maids because my powers didn’t come to form. It was a life where I agonized over whether I would be happier in death. That is, until I found another ‘me’.

“I finally found you. Hi, the current me. Won’t you enter into a contract with me? You’re far too special to live like this, you see.”

A miracle appeared in front of me, who was, again, vomiting as well. The person who lived as me in my previous life.

“I’ll make you into this continent’s best Enchanter.”

description.pt-br:
"Por favor, seja um usuário de espírito que represente nossa família."

Essa boa vontade não durou muito.

Graças à minha grande afinidade com espíritos, fui adotado por uma família. Era uma vida desprezada até pelas empregadas, porque minha habilidade não correspondia às expectativas. Foi uma vida em que me perguntavam se seria feliz se morresse. Até que eu conheci outro 'eu.'

"Eu finalmente encontrei. Olá, sou eu. Você não vai assinar um contrato comigo? Seria um desperdício viver assim."

Um milagre aconteceu comigo hoje.  Uma pessoa que viveu minha vida anterior.  Maristella, uma vilã rara que quase levou o reino à ruína.  Ela disse que me salvaria.

"Em troca, você tem que me dar o que eu quero."

description.fr:
Avec le cœur tremblant, il s’est présenté au rendez-vous arrangé tout en dissimulant sa véritable identité.

“Voici mon grand-père, mon père, ma mère, mon grand frère et mon oncle !”

Pourquoi, bon sang, tous ces foutus héros sont-ils rassemblés devant moi ?!

Il s’avère que la famille de ma petite amie est une lignée de héros parmi les plus puissants ?!

An Jae-rim, un vilain connu sous le nom de “Exécuteur”, tente de jouer le rôle du gendre parfait tout en cachant sa véritable identité et en essayant de se débarrasser de sa belle-famille. Mais ce n’est pas aussi simple qu’il le pensait !

Pour couronner le tout, ils me prennent pour un aspirant héros alors que je suis un méchant !

Une comédie d’action hilarante pleine de tension et de rebondissements !

description.en: Kim Jinho and Heo Chundo are trying to find ways to spend their lazy summer days. Suddenly, two women appear before them with a job proposition for them. Details? None, except that they will be "treasure hunting." With nothing better to do–and no other choice available to them–they are forced to accept. And so begins their journey of exploration, adventure, gags, dungeons, magic items, and guardian beasts.

The bow is a weapon that dominates everything in sight, even for targets hiding at distances too far for the eyes to see. Just imagine a weapon you cannot even see targeting your life. What could possibly be scarier than that? A training regime from hell with a brutal grandfather. A joyful trip to Zhongyuan in search of a wife. The rise of a hero who will overturn the Murim world. Ki Guided Arrow - a fresh take on Ki Guidance that is stronger than both the Ki Guided Sword and Blade! Fire the arrow into tomorrow!

description.en:
Have you ever wondered why Koreans ask you about your blood type? It’s not because they want to know what to do in case you happen to be in an accident (although it really is vital information), but it’s because there is a underlying belief that blood types affect personalities and character in the way an astrological sign may.  
  
Another hugely successful webtoon, it has packed all the existing stereotypes of each blood type and more into a hilarious series. Strangely enough, there are many which are so darn true it’s kind of uncanny. Much funnier when you know your own blood type.

What is the mystery behind this child, and why does he grow so fast?  
  
Read it on Tapastic.com

Kim Si-seup, A man whose destiny is to fight with the forces of the otherworld for the rest of his life.

He was rumored to be a prodigy when he was a child, but fate wasn’t on his side.
The artist that he visited to find out the identity of the woman that appeared in his dreams every night only said things that he couldn’t understand…
“The world is not everything you see. Maybe there’s another world we don’t know about… This is the kind of story it is.”

As he lives in this world, he realizes the existence of another world.
He’s a man who struggled pitifully in order to protect the life and way of this world. The story of “Kim Si-seup” begins! This is a crossover fantasy historical manhwa happening between Joseon and Seoul!

Seolru, a novice hunter who lives alone in the deep mountains with her elderly father, because the weather around her changes constantly depending on her emotions. One day, she goes on a night hunt to catch a badger instead of her father and accidentally shoots a person...

«Father, what should I do now? I think I killed a man!»

Ryun, the crown prince of Cloud Dragon, went hunting with his servants, but was caught up in the empress' scheme and wandered the hunting grounds alone. To make matters worse, he collapses after being hit by an arrow shot by Seolru. Gathering all the remaining strength, he tried to kill the killer who approached him, but even that failed...

«Why did you keep me alive? Did they tell you to let me live, because they will come and cut my throat?»

But the killer who's the size of a rat in front of him is not a killer! Besides, he wasn't even a boy, he was a girl in disguise? Seolru, carrying her own sin of hurting the body of the national treasure by shooting an arrow and her father who thrust a dagger unaware of his identity, eventually becomes a trophy of war and follows Ryun into the imperial palace.. The land of dragons hidden by clouds. ‘Seolru’, a young dragon who knows how to command the sky, and ‘Ryun’, the Crown Prince of Unryong, who greedily keeps her by his side.

Can the love between the two, which has just blossomed from the wrong desires surrounding the legends and oracles that have been handed down since the beginning of time, be preserved until eternity?

description.en:
[As soon as you want to reveal your secret, it turns to be a spell.]*  
  
There is a secret in every love.  
And sometimes you want to reveal that secret that you’ve been hiding deep inside your heart.  
  
When the long unrequited love becomes burdensome;  
When you wander between love and friendship;  
When you can't be sure of your feelings;  
When you don't have the courage to speak from your heart..  
People often reveal their secrets like this:   
  
"This is about someone I know…"  
  
The one at the end of a long unrequited love, Baek Jaehyun

A pulse-quickening tale of swords, sorcery, far-away kingdoms, and the fairest princess in the land… with a twist.  
When Prince Jed's bride-to-be, Elena, elopes two days before their wedding, her desperate family dresses up their youngest son Nicole and sends him to get married in her place. Przed wami znajduje się opowieść która przyprawi was o szybsze bicie serca. „Boy Princess” jest cudowną historią o książętach, rycerzach i magii odległych krain, gdzie uroda księżniczek zapiera dech w piersiach… Przebiegłych księżniczek!  
Gdy jedna z księżniczek na dwa dni przed swoim ślubem ucieka razem z chłopcem stajennym, jej zdesperowana rodzina przebiera najmłodszego księcia i podstawia go w jej miejsce. Dzięki jego pięknym, niebieskim oczom, kaskadzie blond włosów i strategicznie umiejscowionymi jabłkami, nikt nie ma cienia wątpliwości co do prawdziwości rzekomej księżniczki.

Wbrew wszystkim różnicom dzielących obydwoje książąt, powoli i nieświadomie w ich ekscentryczne relacje wkrada się hipnotyczna zażyłość romansu.

description.en: It's Christmas Eve. Failing to confess to Yuji Sunbae, Gyunwoo meets a boy dressed in a space suit who's fallen like a shooting star. It's been a month since he's taken care of the strange boy who has nowhere to go, and today is the day of the high school entrance ceremony! Gyunwoo is excited to hear that he's attending the same school as Yuji Sunbae, but a transfer student who looks ex.act.ly. like Yuji Sunbae appears in front of him…

"Once you’re in, the only way out is death!"

Former hitman Jeong Do-gyun thought he’d left that life behind. Now retired, he keeps a low profile, working at a café run by Gu Sang-hyeok—the closest thing to family he has following their days spent in an orphanage.

But one day, Sang-hyeok vanishes without a trace. Following his trail, Do-gyun finds himself on a remote, mysterious island—only to discover a horrifying truth. The island is a prison, filled with kidnapped victims forced into slavery, watched over by merciless killers.

And to make matters worse, the man who murdered his family is here, too.

With a vengeance burning in his veins, Do-gyun prepares for the fight of his life. It’s him against an army of ruthless assassins—only one side is making it out alive.

title.en: National High School of Economic Freedom - Saesil High

description.en: The government of South Korea establishes an experimental school designed to develop young, financially independent entrepreneurs. Ryuk and his childhood friend both enroll, each enrolling for separate reasons. Ryuk wants to coast off of the 10000000won(approx $10000) that you receive as part of your admission package so he can be financially independent of his parents. The girl wants to gain experience to start her own restaurant to repay her single father. However, they both soon learn that the school is much harsher than the promotional material made it out to be. A dog eats dog world of economic turbulence!

"Shin Yi-seok, a transfer student from the countryside who is rumored to be scheming due to his rough appearance, witnesses the cunning secret of Jo Hae-joo, the first-class student in the school, whom he fell in love with at first sight... Questions about him gradually grow like a snowball. Shin Yi-seok's unrequited love for Jo Hae-ju, who is red on the outside and white on the inside, begins!"

At the end of that first meeting on that rainy day… I didn't know what was really waiting for me.  
And I wonder, if I had known, would I have had this love?  
If instead of confessing a desperate love, I would have measured the consequences between good and bad, then could we love each other forever?  
  
  
—–  
  
Al final de aquel primer encuentro en ese día lluvioso… Yo no sabía lo que realmente me esperaba.  
Y me preguntó, de haberlo sabido, ¿Habría comenzado este amor?  
Si en lugar de confesar un amor desesperado, hubiese medido las consecuencias entre lo bueno y lo malo, entonces, ¿podríamos amarnos para siempre?

title.en: I Didn't Have It but Now I Do

description.en: "If that's sunbaenim’s preference, then I'll change.” Hong, who took the courage to confess to his beloved sunbae Dowon, is rejected on the spot. A suspicious woman approaches Hong, who is frustrated that all her hope has disappeared. Hong, who took the medicine that has been recommended by the suspicious woman, has became the ideal type of Dowon, and made a stronger move on him. It's starting! Hyun's pure hearted love that only looks at sunbae and thinks about sunbae can be really a happy ending?!

Our protagonist Kang Hae Yo is not an ordinary high school girl by any measure. She is in fact a jjang of her school and her gang is the most powerful in Seoul. But she wants a normal life and a normal boyfriend. Her hot-bloodedness always get in her way. And her quick-temper when she encounters "wimps", by her standards, make her desire all the more unreachable.  
  
This is the year 2002. Every youngster gets to chat online once in a while. And Kang Hae Yo is no exception as she goes on the web under the nickname "playgirl18". She doesn't really know her way around the computer But her sub-jjang, Yoon Ji Ni, teaches her the "necessary things for online chatting" – like how to be girly. Hae Yo begins to find for herself a new life from online chatting. She begins to think of online chatting as her only way out from gang life. What will happen?

biography.en: Not an actual artist, but a pseudonym created by the Korean magazine Kkotnim to publish a mass amount of "house style" manhwa.

description.en: Eunho Cha is, without a doubt, the biggest outcast at school. He spends his days avoiding bullies and daydreaming about his crush. He'd give anything to be popular, so when he discovers a face editing app called Icing, he spies an opportunity. With Icing's help, Eunho now looks like a superstar... or at least Ganzi Monster (GM), his online alter ego, does. But just when GM and his dance videos are starting to get popular, someone discovers his secret, and Eunho's days of being invisible are about to come to an end...

Uhyeon Baek logs into Reverse Planet expecting a VR game, only to discover that the world is painfully real. A decade of grief and experiments turns him into a superhuman contract killer, and he finally executes the director behind his suffering. But when he returns to his original life, the ghosts of his fallen companions follow him. Haunted and restless, he goes back to Reverse Planet, only to realize he's entered the real game this time. Paired with superstar streamer Soyul Kang, his lethal efficiency goes viral... and puts him on the conspirator's radar.
description.ko:
생체 실험에서 벗어나 초월자가 되었다. 남은 것은 미완의 복수뿐. 
「현실로 귀환한 기분은 어떻습니까?」 
「내가 멸망이라 불렸던 이유를 알려 주지.」
description.pt-br:
Baek Woohyun escapou do jogo mortal [Reverse Planet] e voltou para casa. Mas o jogo o seguiu. Ele pensou que estava livre, mas as sombras vingativas de seus amigos mortos o assombram, exigindo vingança.
Para desvendar a conspiração que conecta os dois mundos, ele loga novamente no jogo. Desta vez, do lado seguro da tela… ou assim ele pensava. Sua aparição acidental na transmissão de uma streamer o expõe. E então, uma mensagem anônima prova que alguém sabe seu segredo.
“Como se sente por ter voltado à realidade?”

description.en:
She woke up inthe body of the male lead's ex-wife, who abused the young male lead. According to the original story, the male lead would fall in love with the princess of a fallen kingdom on the battlefield and bring her back!

Unlike the original story where she only clings to him and acts wickedly after he returns with military achievements, she plan to quietly accept the divorce.

She'll raise her young husband like a younger brother, nurturing him well before sending him off to war. While she's at it, she also secured some money and managed the fiefdom well. And unlike the original story, she developed a cure because she didn't want to die from an incurable disease.

Now all that's left is to get divorced!
___
Cavil Sernua is the bastard son of House Sernua and the male lead of this story. His story begins in an orphanage, but he soon grows up to be a respectable figure who's loved by all. The villainess is Cavil's wife, Elodi McClaire, the character I transmigrated into. Elodi is cruel and evil, and she met her tragic ending in the book. However, I will not follow in her footsteps. Instead, I will raise Cavil well and divorce him so he can end up with his true love. Well, that is... if he'll let me.
description.fr: Pendant que mon mari est parti faire la guerre, je me prépare pour notre divorce. Mais à son retour, il s'est transformé en un mâle alpha sexy. C'est tentant... mais je dois tenir bon. Lorsqu'il apprend mes projets, mon mari m'accuse d'avoir un amant et de vouloir s'enfuir pour être avec lui. Que doit faire une future ex-femme?!
description.ko:
어린 남주를 학대하는, 남주의 전 부인에 빙의했다.
원작대로라면 남주는 전쟁터에서 망국의 공주와 사랑에 빠져 그녀를 데려올 것이다!

남편이 공을 세우고 돌아오니 그제야 매달리며 패악을 부리는 원작과 달리,
나는 얌전히 이혼을 당할 생각이다.

어린 남편을 막냇동생 대하듯 잘 키워 전쟁터로 보내고,
그러는 김에 돈도 좀 챙기고, 영지도 잘 꾸려나갔다.
또 원작처럼 불치병에 걸려 죽기 싫어서 치료제도 개발했다.

이제 남은 건 이혼당하는 것뿐!

====

그런데 돌아온 꼬마남편, 아니 엄청 커버린 남편의 반응이 이상하다.

"내가 전쟁터를 구르는 동안, 부인은 도망갈 준비를 하셨군요."

그가 커다란 손으로 허리를 휘감으며 위험하게 웃었다.

"그새 바람이라도 난 겁니까?"

예쁘게 올라간 입꼬리와 달리, 눈은 뜨겁게 불타고 있었다.

아니…… 저기, 나 이혼당할 준비 끝냈는데…….
description.ru:
Я стала бывшей женой главного героя, которая издевалась над ним в детстве.
Если бы всё шло по оригиналу, главный герой влюбился бы в принцессу, павшей нации, на поле боя и вернул бы её к жизни!

В отличие от оригинального произведения, где муж возвращается после свершения великих подвигов, а жена привязывается к нему и начинает вести себя агрессивно,
Я планирую спокойно пройти через развод.

Хорошо воспитав своего молодого мужа, как младшего братом, отправила его на поле боя, а заодно заработала немного денег я хорошо управляла своим имением.
Кроме того, я не хотела умирать от неизлечимой болезни, как и в оригинале, поэтому разработала лекарство.

Теперь осталось только развестись!

====

Но реакция моего маленького мужа, который вернулся, нет, моего мужа, который так вырос, странная.

— "Пока я мотался по полю боя, моя жена готовилась к побегу."

Он опасно улыбнулся, обхватив её талию своими большими руками.

— "А ветер тем временем подул?"

В отличие от красиво приподнятых уголков губ, глаза её горели жаром.

— "Нет… эй, я готов развестись…"
description.zh: 附身了虐待小男主的前妻。 为了避免后期被报复。 我打算乖乖地接受离婚。 但是回来的小丈夫,不,长大了很多的丈夫的反应很奇怪。 "在我拼搏在战场的时候，夫人做好了逃跑的准备。" 他用一只大手叉着腰危险地笑了。 "这会儿出轨了吗？" 与漂亮的嘴角不同，眼睛在火热地燃烧着。 我说…… 那个，我准备离婚了

A mysterious guy who failed every exam has now awakened!! What will this guy do to make the world change?!!!

description.en:
Arin, the adopted daughter of a chaebol family, harbours a twisted affection for her stepmother. After she becomes an adult, Arin accidentally realises that she has unusual abilities.
She tries to use her abilities to attract her stepmother's attention, but her stepbrothers, not her stepmother, want Arin...

A dangerous adopted daughter who shakes up the conglomerate 'Rare Moon' family. Her twisted red romance!

Do Do-Hee is the successor of the Future Group. She has an arrogant and cool-headed personality, who doesn’t trust in anyone and is cynical about love. Do Do-Hee gets involved with a demon named Jung Gu-Won and makes a contract marriage with him.

He can live for eternity by making dangerous, but sweet deals with humans who endure hellish lives. But after looking down upon humans for 200 years, he gets involved with Do Do-Hee and somehow loses his power. To prevent his own extinction, he must protect Do Do-Hee who has taken all of his power.

This is the webtoon version of the K-Drama with the same title which aired on Nov 24, 2023

Heo Soo Ran is a full spirited trainee reporter, unfortunately she is quite the fool and makes a lot of mistakes during her training. To avoid being fired she sneaked secretly to get exclusive information from the number one criminal gang 'black snake'. After succeeding, her identity was instantly discovered by agent 'blue', the cold blooded elite agent. 'Blue' pointing his gun and told her that he would kill her if she doesn't leave the 'black snake'. Will Hae Soo Ran be able to avoid the danger she's in and get some exclusive information? Will a miracle help her?

altTitles.en: An Equation with No Wrong Answers

description.en: Kang Jae-i lives a strictly calculated life revolving around rigorous study schedules and meticulous routines. However, his orderly world is turned upside down when a free-spirited transfer student, Ha I-sol, takes the seat next to him. After a terrible first impression leads to a high-stakes academic bet between them, these polar opposites begin to understand one another and gradually transform each other's lives. A youth romance between an honor student who only believed in correct answers and a rebellious transfer student.
description.es-la: Kang Jae-i vive una vida estrictamente calculada y guiada por horarios de estudio y rutinas minuciosas. Sin embargo, su mundo ordenado se pone de cabeza cuando Ha I-sol, una estudiante transferida de espíritu libre, se sienta a su lado. Tras una pésima primera impresión que desencadena una apuesta académica entre ambos, estos dos polos opuestos comienzan a comprenderse y a cambiar poco a poco el mundo del otro. Un romance juvenil sobre un estudiante modelo que solo creía en las respuestas correctas y una chica que sigue sus propias reglas.

description.en:
Ordinary high school student Jururu is on the verge of death in a sudden accident on her way home from school as usual.

But then a mysterious woman appears and saves Jururu by turning time back, and tells her that things like this will continue to happen in the future, however there is only way to survive.

That is to help Gosegu to help her achieve what she wants! Jururu, who had no choice but to listen to it in order to live, She meets Gosegu, who has transferred to her class the next day, but Gosegu gives her an unexpected proposal...

"Would you like to become an idol with me?!" "What do you mean, Segu...?"

Jururu really helped Go Segu and became an idol.

Will she be able to overcome her death?!

세상의 종말을 눈앞에 둔 니젤.
그러나 그보다 빠르게 자신의 충직한 기사, 이나스에게 살해당하고 만다.

믿을 수 없는 사실에 절망하기도 잠시, 정신을 차려 보니 과거로 돌아와 있었다.
